inputs.note: graph is the shared 120-node fixture (>= base_init_threshold=64) so this takes the label_prop_loop + node_embedding-upscaling path, NOT the small-graph PCA/random/spectral/mds base case. recursive_init=False keeps this to a single non-recursive level (no nested label_propagation_init / no sklearn PCA call). label_propagation_init does NOT draw from tau_rand/rng_state itself for its own logic -- ALL its randomness is either (a) delegated to label_prop_loop (which draws lp_rng_state + lp_seed_position_draws from the passed numpy RandomState, then uses tau_rand internally with that FIXED rng_state array) or (b) delegated to node_embedding (called with initial_embedding=None on this path, so node_embedding draws its OWN init from the same advancing RandomState -- see node_embedding_init_normal/rng_val/shuffles below). Draw order recorded here is exactly the call order: lp_rng_state (1x3 int64), lp_seed_position_draws (approx_n_parts scalars, one per label_prop_loop seeding iteration), node_embedding_init_normal (reduced_graph.shape[0] x n_components floats -- reduced_graph is the label-propagation-partitioned graph, NOT the input graph; its size is data-dependent, read its shape off this array), node_embedding_rng_val (n_embedding_epochs ints, one per SGD epoch), node_embedding_shuffles (n_embedding_epochs permutation arrays of node_order, applied one per epoch AFTER that epoch's SGD update, each of length reduced_graph.shape[0]). Feed lp_rng_state/lp_seed_position_draws into a replay of label_prop_loop's body (label_prop_iteration x n_iter, then ONE label_outliers, then remap_labels -- see label_prop_loop_n120 fixture for that in isolation), then build the reduced graph exactly as label_propagation_init does (base_reduction_map / normalized_reduction_map / reduced_graph = normalized_reduction_map.T @ graph @ base_reduction_map, clipped to [0,1]), then feed node_embedding_init_normal as node_embedding's initial_embedding and node_embedding_rng_val[n]/node_embedding_shuffles[n] as its per-epoch RNG source (see node_embedding fixtures for exact epoch semantics), then finish with the partition_expander upscaling algebra (no further randomness) to get the final n_points x n_components embedding. Determinism was verified: an independent RandomState(321) replay of the WHOLE function reproduces this embedding bit-for-bit.
